      result = (result * n) % p;
    }

import 'dart:math';

int hexKey(String num) {
  int length = num.length;
  List<int> result = [];
  
  for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
    if (num[i] == '#') {
      result.add(1);
      continue;
    }
    
    if ('0' <= num[i] && num[i] <= '9') {
      result.add(int.parse(num[i]));
      continue;
    } else if ('a' <= num[i].toLowerCase() && num[i].toLowerCase() <= 'f') {
      result.add((num[i].toUpperCase().codeUnitAt(0) - 'A'.codeUnitAt(0)) + 10);
      continue;
    } else if ('A' <= num[i] && num[i] <= 'F') {
      result.add((num[i].codeUnitAt(0) - 'A'.codeUnitAt(0)) + 10);
      continue;
    } 
  }

  return result.fold(0, (prev, element) => prev * 256 + element);
}

List<int> makeAPile(int n) {
  if (n == 0) return [];
  
  List<int> pile = [1];
  int currentNumber = 2;
  while (pile.length < n) {
    bool isAdded = false;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < pile.length && !isAdded; ++i) {
      if (currentNumber % pile[i] == 0 || pile[i] % currentNumber == 0) {
        pile.add(currentNumber);
        isAdded = true;
        break;
      }
    }
    
    if (!isAdded) {
      // If no number in the pile divides or is divided by currentNumber,
      // then it's a prime and we need to add it to the pile.
      pile.add(currentNumber);
    }
    
    currentNumber++;
  }
  
  return pile;
}

import 'dart:math';

List<int> maximum(List<int> arr, int k) {
  if (arr.isEmpty || k <= 0) return [];
  
  List<int> result = [];
  int n = arr.length;
  for (int i = 0; i < n - k + 1; i++) {
    int maxVal = arr[i];
    for (int j = i + 1; j < i + k; j++) {
      if (arr[j] > maxVal) {
        maxVal = arr[j];
      }
    }
    result.add(maxVal);
  }
  return result;
}

int specialFactorial(int n) {

  int result = 1;
  for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
    result *= i;
  }

    push rbp              ; Save previous base pointer
    mov rbp, rsp          ; Set new base pointer
    sub rsp, 8            ; Allocate space on stack

    cmp rdi, 1            ; Check if n == 0 or 1
    jle end_specialFactorial

    inc rcx               ; Increment counter
    cmp rcx, rdi          ; Compare count to n
    jl loop_factorial     ; If not done yet, continue looping

    pop rbp               ; Restore previous base pointer
    ret                   ; Return the result in RAX
